environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS cluster in us-east-1. Service is exposed via a Kubernetes NodePort service (port 30080) with no ingress controller. The worker nodes have public IPs assigned via the VPC subnet auto-assign setting. Security group sg-0a4f2e8b allows inbound TCP/30080 from 0.0.0.0/0 (configured during initial debugging, never reverted). No network policies applied to the namespace.
